in_arabic.name: Labeeqa
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Seeker of knowledge
in_arabic.long_meaning: Labeeqa هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. One who is always in search of knowledge and wisdom, derived from the Arabic word 'labat' which means 'to seek' or 'to ask'.
